detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic realism with soft dawn light, restrained pastel colors, natural skin texture, realistic wet stone, delicate wisteria petals, and subtle atmospheric depth. The palette combines lavender, muted green, dark wood, pale gold sunlight, and cool reflections from the rain-washed courtyard.
[Shot 1] The single continuous 8-second shot opens in a quiet Jiangnan courtyard just after light rain. <Subject 1> is shown full-body in a medium-wide composition, walking toward the camera along a damp stone path beneath hanging lavender wisteria. A shallow pond lies on screen left, while a dark wooden veranda and lattice windows extend along screen right. She wears exactly the lavender dress and matching sandals defined by <Picture 1>. Her identity, hairstyle, clothing design, floral embroidery, and footwear are fully preserved.
From 00:00.000 to 00:02.500, she takes three measured steps toward the camera. Each heel makes secure contact with the wet stone before her weight transfers forward. Her arms swing with small natural amplitude; the dress hem moves gently around her ankles, and her long hair responds to a light breeze without changing length or style. The camera performs a slow, stabilized backward dolly at walking speed, maintaining the original distance.
From 00:02.500 to 00:05.300, she slows beneath a low wisteria cluster and stops smoothly. She raises her right hand, opens her fingers, and brushes the hanging flowers once with the backs of her fingertips. The flexible stem bends slightly and returns, releasing six to eight individual petals that drift downward with natural gravity. Her gaze follows the petals while her left arm remains relaxed beside her body. The camera begins a very small, slow arc of approximately eight degrees around her left side.
From 00:05.300 to 00:08.000, she lowers her right hand, pivots her shoulders approximately twenty degrees toward the camera, and turns her head last. She performs one natural blink and forms a warm closed-mouth smile while maintaining direct eye contact. The falling petals pass through the foreground as she settles into a relaxed three-quarter pose. The camera finishes with a subtle four-percent push-in, ending on a balanced medium-full portrait.
Maintain one woman only. Preserve facial identity, finger count, hair volume, dress length, floral pattern placement, sandal construction, and body anatomy without morphing or flicker. Keep the stone path, pond, veranda, wisteria, and architecture stable. Do not add people, duplicate limbs, text, subtitles, logos, bags, jewelry, or new props. Avoid slipping feet, floating petals, cloth clipping, warped hands, changing footwear, moving architecture, or exaggerated wind.
overall_soundscape:
Soft morning birds, a light breeze moving through wisteria leaves, gentle water trickling into the pond, and distant courtyard ambience. Her sandals produce three restrained taps on the damp stone, accompanied by quiet dress and hair rustling. No speech.
